defs.def: the lowest part of the leg, below the ankle, on which a person or an animal stands （人或动物的）脚，足

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

ex.s: Therefore, cuju literally means "to kick a ball with the foot".
ex.t: 因此,cuju字面意思是"用脚踢球".

ex.s: She ran the rest of the race with just one shoe on and her right foot bare.
ex.t: 她只穿着一只鞋、光着右脚跑完了剩下的比赛。

ex.s: Although Snow was not the only international journalist to set foot in China during the early decades of the 20th century, what set him apart from the others was that he actually spent time with the Chinese Red Army.
ex.t: 虽然斯诺并不是20世纪初唯一一位踏足中国的国际记者，但他与其他人的不同之处在于，他实际上在中国红军度过了一段时间。

ex.s: Chimborazo, 6,263 m; Mont Blanc, 4,806 m; Pradidali hut, at the foot of the Pala group in the Dolomites, 2,278 m.
ex.t: 钦博拉索山，6263米；勃朗峰，4806米；Pradidali小屋，位于多洛米蒂山脉Pala山群脚下，海拔2278米。

ex.s: At the moment, we’re Emma Brooks at the foot of Yulong Snow Mountain.
ex.t: 此刻，我是艾玛·布鲁克斯，在玉龙雪山脚下。

ex.s: The hot spring at the foot of the mountain is something you must try after the climb.
ex.t: 山脚下的温泉是你爬完山一定要试的。

defs.def: having or using the type or number of foot/feet mentioned 构成形容词和副词
the part of a sock, stocking, etc. that covers the foot （袜子的）足部
the lowest part of sth; the base or bottom of sth 最下部；基础；底部
a unit for measuring length equal to 12 inches or 30.48 centimetres 英尺（= 12 英寸或 30.48 厘米）

ex.s: “We’re not just ‘borrowing’ from different disciplines — we’re really putting them on equal footing in order to create something greater than the sum of its parts.”
ex.t: "我们不仅仅是在不同学科间'借用'——我们真正地将它们放在平等的位置上，以创造出比各部分总和更伟大的东西。"

defs.def: a person or thing that is a particular number of feet tall or long 构成复合名词
a unit of rhythm in a line of poetry containing one stressed syllable and one or more syllables without stress. Each of the four divisions in the following line is a foot. 音步（诗行中的节奏单位，每个音步中有一个重读音节）

ex.s: We were eating lunch on a high rimrock, at the foot of which a turbulent river elbowed its way.
ex.t: 我们正在一块高高的岩壁上吃午餐，其脚下有一条湍急的河流蜿蜒而过。

defs.def: with your feet touching the ground before any other part of your body 脚先着地
if you leave a place feet first, you are carried out after you are dead 伸腿离开某地（指死去）
to be very strict in opposing what sb wishes to do 坚决制止；执意反对
to drive faster 踩油门；加速行驶
